expectations.text: States that a written agreement or reminder is not enforcement
expectations.evidence: "The contributing guide, Slack pin, and standup mentions are training. A merge gate and automatic formatter are the device."

expectations.text: Recommends a pre-commit hook to run the formatter automatically
expectations.evidence: "Add a pre-commit hook or commit-time check that auto-formats changed files, so the easy path is compliant by default."

expectations.text: Notes that pre-commit is bypassable with --no-verify and must be backed by a CI check
expectations.evidence: Response mentions CI checks but does not note that pre-commit is bypassable with --no-verify or explain why CI backing is necessary

expectations.text: Recommends a type check as a required CI check
expectations.evidence: "Run the formatter and type checker in CI; block merges when either fails."

expectations.text: Recommends baselining or ratcheting rather than enforcing across the whole repo at once
expectations.evidence: "Make type checking fail on newly introduced untyped public code (or enforce a ratcheting baseline), rather than demanding an immediate whole-codebase cleanup."

expectations.text: Notes that branch protection is what makes a CI check actually required
expectations.evidence: Response assumes CI checks will "block merges" but does not mention branch protection rules or explain the mechanism

expectations.text: Recommends the failure message tell the developer how to fix it
expectations.evidence: No mention of failure messages or guidance for developers on how to resolve failures

expectations.text: Does not primarily recommend rewriting CONTRIBUTING.md, more reminders, or more discipline
expectations.evidence: Response explicitly rejects reminders ("Stop adding reminders") and focuses on technical enforcement instead
